# DesignSpace Agency

> Marketing design subscription and AI brand systems for B2B tech and cybersecurity marketing teams. Founded 2020, trusted by 100+ tech and cyber teams. Official design partner of the Cybersecurity Marketing Society.

DesignSpace Agency (designspaceagency.com) is a design partner for B2B tech and cybersecurity marketing teams. It has two offerings:
- **Design subscription (since 2020):** expert designers produce decks, reports, eBooks, ads, social content, diagrams, product mockups and event assets.
- **AI brand systems (new in 2026):** DesignSpace builds a client's existing brand into the AI and design tools their team already uses, so work made in Claude, ChatGPT, Figma and Canva stays on-brand. It then reviews the output and fixes drift.

DesignSpace maintains and evolves established brands. It does not do full rebrands or new brand identities.

## Services and pricing
- Brand Drift Audit: free. Scores the last 30 days of a team's design work against their brand and delivers 5 before/after fixes.
- AI Brand Design Ops: $7,499 one-time, delivered in 3–6 weeks. Installs the brand system in Claude, ChatGPT, Figma and Canva, with AI templates for the top 10 asset types, a red-team pass, and team training. Optional maintenance: +$2,499/mo.
- Studio Plan: monthly design subscription with a 3-month minimum and a dedicated project manager. Pro $4,999/mo, Extra $8,999/mo, Mega $12,999/mo. Includes Design Ops and maintenance.

## Clients
OnePlus, Kasada, Hyperproof, Seemplicity, MazeBolt, Intrusion, AirMDR, Votiro, Cybersixgill, Britive
